SCENE sc_001 0-120880 INT. DOWAGER DUCHESS'S BEDCHAMBER – NIGHT
EP26:E1 0-5800 CAMERA: Wide shot framed through heavy bed curtains in a dark, candlelit bedchamber. Juliana in her maid's apron sits vigilantly beside the canopied bed where the frail Dowager Duchess lies.
EP26:E2 0-5500 ACTION: Juliana glances nervously back toward the door, ensuring no guards are near, before turning her full attention back to the ailing Duchess.
EP26:E3 5800-10500 CAMERA: Close-up of Juliana's hands unscrewing the glass dropper from a small amber medicine bottle filled with dark medicinal liquid.
EP26:E4 6500-9000 SOUND: Tense, atmospheric orchestral score builds softly in the background.
EP26:E5 10500-14200 CAMERA: Close-up of the Dowager Duchess resting against pale pillows as her heavy eyelids slowly open, her gaze weak and disoriented.
EP26:E6 11000-14000 ACTION: The Dowager Duchess blinks against the dim lamplight, turning her head toward Juliana.
EP26:E7 14200-20500 CAMERA: Low-angle medium two-shot looking past Juliana's silhouette down to the Duchess in bed.
EP26:E8 14200-20200 DOWAGER DUCHESS [Weak, Raspy]: "Who are you? Speak to me. I have not seen your face before."
EP26:E9 20500-25800 CAMERA: Close-up of Juliana leaning over the bed, holding the dropper bottle carefully toward the Duchess's mouth, her expression urgent yet tender.
EP26:E10 20600-25400 JULIANA [Urgent, Reassuring]: "Please, Your Grace. Drink the last of this antidote. Drink it slowly."
EP26:E11 25800-28500 CAMERA: Extreme close-up of the Duchess taking drops of the dark liquid from the glass bottle onto her lips.
EP26:E12 25800-28400 ACTION: The Duchess swallows the remedy with difficulty as Juliana carefully tilts the amber bottle.
EP26:E13 28500-30800 CAMERA: Medium two-shot as Juliana withdraws the medicine bottle, standing beside the bedside lamp.
EP26:E14 30800-35800 CAMERA: Close-up of the Dowager Duchess observing Juliana with faint recognition through her exhaustion.
EP26:E15 30800-35500 DOWAGER DUCHESS [Faint, Discerning]: "You... you are no common servant. You took Catherine's whip for me the other day."
EP26:E16 35800-40200 CAMERA: Close-up of Juliana, her eyes reflecting quiet resolve and pain.
EP26:E17 36000-39800 JULIANA [Humble, Sincere]: "I did what I had to. It does not change my duty."
EP26:E18 40200-43200 CAMERA: Medium two-shot as Juliana leans closer to tuck the blankets securely over the Duchess.
EP26:E19 40300-43000 JULIANA [Gentle, Calming]: "Rest now, Your Grace. You are safe tonight."
EP26:E20 43200-47500 CAMERA: Close-up of Juliana looking around the shadowy room, her voice dropping to a tense whisper.
EP26:E21 43500-47000 JULIANA [Hushed, Tense Whisper]: "If the guards hear us, we are both dead."
EP26:E22 47500-50800 CAMERA: Static shot of the heavy carved double doors to the bedchamber, left slightly ajar with a sliver of hallway candlelight gleaming through the gap.
EP26:E23 50800-55800 CAMERA: Close-up of the Dowager Duchess lying back, processing Juliana's warning as dark realization settles into her face.
EP26:E24 52500-55500 ACTION: The Duchess clutches the blanket against her chest, her breathing quickening with dismay.
EP26:E25 55800-62500 CAMERA: Medium close-up of the Duchess looking upward toward Juliana, her voice trembling with tragic certainty.
EP26:E26 56000-62000 DOWAGER DUCHESS [Trembling, Heartbroken]: "Rupert and Catherine want me dead. They are poisoning me in my own bed, aren't they?"
EP26:E27 62500-67000 CAMERA: Medium shot of Juliana leaning over the edge of the mattress, nodding earnestly to soothe her fears.
EP26:E28 62600-66700 JULIANA [Reassuring, Steadfast]: "Yes. But the charcoal is fighting the poison. You are safe now."
EP26:E29 67000-71800 CAMERA: Close-up of the small amber dropper bottle sitting atop the polished wooden bedside table in the dim glow of the lamp.
EP26:E30 71800-79600 CAMERA: Medium shot of the Dowager Duchess looking intently at Juliana from her pillows, studying her bearing.
EP26:E31 73800-79400 DOWAGER DUCHESS [Curious, Searching]: "Then tell me... why is a girl of such noble spirit working as a common maid?"
EP26:E32 79600-86500 CAMERA: Close-up of Juliana, her chin lifting with dignified sorrow and quiet defiance.
EP26:E33 80000-85800 JULIANA [Painful, Proud]: "Because my family cast me out to rot. I have nothing left in this world but my honor."
EP26:E34 86500-90800 CAMERA: Medium tracking down Juliana's apron to her hand as she rests it against the bed linens, revealing a distinctive engraved signet ring on her finger.
EP26:E35 87000-90500 ACTION: Juliana rests her right hand against the edge of the bedcover, unwittingly placing the unique ring directly within the Duchess's line of sight.
EP26:E36 90200-92000 SOUND: A sharp, stunned gasp.
EP26:E37 90800-95000 CAMERA: Extreme close-up of the Dowager Duchess gasping sharply, her eyes widening in profound shock as all color drains from her face.
EP26:E38 90800-95000 ACTION: The Duchess's mouth hangs open in pure disbelief as she stares fixedly at Juliana's hand.
EP26:E39 95000-100000 CAMERA: Medium shot of the Duchess pushing herself up against the headboard, trembling as she stretches out her frail hand.
EP26:E40 96000-99800 DOWAGER DUCHESS [Breathless, Shaken]: "Your hand... Let me see your hand."
EP26:E41 100000-105500 CAMERA: Close-up of Juliana reacting with confusion and growing concern at the elder woman's sudden frenzy.
EP26:E42 100500-105000 JULIANA [Confused, Alarmed]: "Your Grace? What is wrong? You look as though you've seen a ghost."
EP26:E43 105500-109000 CAMERA: Close-up shot of the Duchess's withered, shaking hand reaching across the blanket toward Juliana's arm.
EP26:E44 106000-109000 ACTION: The Duchess reaches outward with trembling fingers, grasping frantically for Juliana.
EP26:E45 108800-110000 SOUND: A sudden sharp rustle of fabric as her fingers snap tight.
EP26:E46 109000-110800 CAMERA: Tight shot of the Duchess's frail hand clamping down with fierce, unexpected strength onto Juliana's dark sleeve.
EP26:E47 109200-110600 DOWAGER DUCHESS [Stern, Desperate]: "Do not move!"
EP26:E48 110800-115800 CAMERA: Close-up of the Dowager Duchess looking up at Juliana with overwhelming urgency and tears brimming in her wide eyes.
EP26:E49 111000-115500 DOWAGER DUCHESS [Intense, Demanding]: "Where... where... Where did you get this ring? Speak to me!"
EP26:E50 115800-119500 CAMERA: Medium close-up of Juliana frozen in shock, her breath catching as the Duchess's desperate words echo in the silence of the room.
EP26:E51 119500-120880 CAMERA: Tight close-up of the Dowager Duchess's two weathered hands tightly clasping Juliana's hand, holding the signet ring between them as a dramatic orchestral cliffhanger chord swells, cutting sharply to black.
